bitter_lake_bath_and_exterior.heading: Bathroom Remodel, Siding Rot Repair, and Exterior Painting in Bitter Lake
bitter_lake_bath_and_exterior.text1: This Bitter Lake project combined a vivid full-bath renovation with siding rot repair and exterior painting. Silver Peak coordinated the detailed bathroom finish work and weather-related exterior repairs as one project.
bitter_lake_bath_and_exterior.text2: The homeowner, an art teacher, wanted a colorful and bright full bath. Turquoise tile, black fixtures, clean white surfaces, and carefully coordinated details bring that vision to life. Outside, the work included repairing rotted siding and painting the home.

part1.small_heading: A sleek shower shaped by the homeowner’s vision
part1.text2: The shower was built around the homeowner’s vision of a sleek, colorful tile wall, with wood-look tile niches and sharp, contrasting black hardware. The niches match the flooring, which ties the whole room together no matter where you look.

part2.small_heading: Smart mirror, medicine cabinet, and vanity
part2.text2: The vanity pairs a dark counter and white cabinet with an under-mount sink and black hardware. Above it, the smart mirror is also a medicine cabinet: the wall behind it was reframed to make full use of the available space.
